name: Kuhnde
description: A former Jeskai mantis rider and prospective phoenix rider in the original timeline of Tarkir.

timeline.summary: In the original Tarkir timeline, the mantis rider Kuhnde defeats a phoenix and hopes to train it as a mount.
timeline.quote: the mantis rider Kuhnde managed to defeat a phoenix and hoped to train it as a mount

citation.text: "Phoenix", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde, a Jeskai monk, stands atop his mantis on a tower and watches the valley, vigilant against the mount he rides.
timeline.quote: Atop a red-roofed Jeskai tower, a monk named Kuhnde stood on his mantis and looked over the valley.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, the young Kuhnde is tested by the masters of the strongholds and found competent in all disciplines, though expert in none, so they recognize him as suited to be a mantis rider.
timeline.quote: He was competent in all the disciplines, although not an expert, but they all recognized in Kuhnde the skill set that was required of being a mantis rider.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Kuhnde meets his mount on the same day; a rider shows him how dangerous a mantis is when a freed tether lets it cut the rider's hand.
timeline.quote: The rider removed one of the mantis's tethers and the insect lashed out, cutting the rider's hand.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde's mantis alerts him to a concealed amber orb of energy racing up the mountain, and he signals the mantis to intercept it.
timeline.quote: Kuhnde's mantis turned its head, alerting him to movement near the base of the mountain.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde leads the orb away from the monastery toward the valley lakes, then turns back and jabs it with his spear.
timeline.quote: He signaled the mantis to go lower, so they could lead the energy ball away from the monastery.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde's spear thrust makes the orb dissipate, and a phoenix emerges and attacks.
timeline.quote: There was a loud screech, one the monks in the monastery would have heard, and the orb dissipated. A phoenix emerged and attacked.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde has the mantis take the phoenix's attack and the mantis wounds the phoenix, which flees toward the monastery's library tower.
timeline.quote: It cut the phoenix with its longer claws, and blood and flame emerged from the wound.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde resolves to protect the library's scrolls with his life, as the Jeskai prize their words above gold.
timeline.quote: Kuhnde would lay down his life protecting them.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde impales the phoenix with his spear, but its flames burn the mantis's wings and both creatures fall and slide down the mountainside.
timeline.quote: His mantis began to fall and he knew why before he saw—its wings were burning.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde finds his mantis of twenty years dying and still trying to kill him.
timeline.quote: He approached it, his companion for twenty years, as it lay dying.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde kills his dying mantis with his spear to end its misery.
timeline.quote: With a quick, precise motion, Kuhnde impaled the mantis's head to end its misery

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde decides against killing the injured phoenix, since it would only be reborn stronger; he rights it and strikes its beak with his spear shaft, beginning to tame it.
timeline.quote: He had never learned how to tame a phoenix, but he knew, given the time, he would master a new way.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Masters of the strongholds test the young Kuhnde and recognize the skills of a mantis rider.
timeline.quote: they all recognized in him the skill set that was required of being a mantis rider

citation.text: "Kuhnde", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A phoenix in a glowing orb attacks the monastery; Kuhnde's mantis fights it and both crash.
timeline.quote: the orb revealed itself as a phoenix as it attacked

citation.text: "Kuhnde", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde impales his dying mantis to end its misery.
timeline.quote: he picked up his spear and impaled the mantis's head to end its misery

citation.text: "Kuhnde", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kuhnde subdues the injured phoenix, striking its beak to control it, resolving to master a new way.
timeline.quote: He had never learned how to tame a phoenix, but he knew, given the time, he would master a new way.

citation.text: "Kuhnde", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A Jeskai monk and mantis rider who spent twenty years learning to ride his mantis and defends his monastery from a phoenix.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.
